speaker: Tarun Gogoi
quote_original: Assam's growth rate has touched 8.1 per cent and is almost at par with the all-India average GDP growth rate.
quote_english: Assam's growth rate has touched 8.1 per cent and is almost at par with the all-India average GDP growth rate.
summary: The Chief Minister said Assam's growth had reached 8.1%, roughly matching the national rate; Planning Commission data at the time showed 8.1%, later revised to 7.34%.

transcript_sources.title: State's GDP growth at par with nation (The Assam Tribune)

evidence.title: State's GDP growth at par with nation
evidence.key_figure: Gogoi, quoting Planning Commission figures: Assam growth 8.1%, almost at par with all-India.

evidence.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Assam
evidence.title: Economic Survey, Assam, 2011-12

analysis:
Tarun Gogoi said Assam's growth rate had reached 8.1% and was almost at par with the all-India average, citing Planning Commission figures released the previous day. India's GDP growth for 2010-11 was then estimated at 8.5%.

Assam's Economic Survey 2011-12 later put the state's 2010-11 growth at 7.34% on quick estimates, while the advance estimate for 2011-12 was 8.42%. The 8.1% figure was therefore a provisional Planning Commission estimate that was subsequently revised down.

At the time of the statement, the 8.1% figure was the official Planning Commission number, and the gap with the 8.5% national estimate was 0.4 percentage points.
notes: The Assam Tribune page metadata shows 2010-09-15 but the text refers to June 15 and the 2011-12 Plan, so the statement date is taken as 2011-06-15. Assam's later quick estimate for 2010-11 was 7.34%.
